title: Orthonormal frames with the same span evaluate all n-covectors equally up to one global sign
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let τ, e : Fin n → ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be orthonormal families (for the Euclidean inner product) with span(range τ) = span(range e). Then one of the following holds:
- α(τ_0, …, τ_{n−1}) = α(e_0, …, e_{n−1}) for every n-covector α, or
- α(τ_0, …, τ_{n−1}) = −α(e_0, …, e_{n−1}) for every n-covector α.
Here an n-covector is a continuous alternating n-linear map α : (ℝ^P)^n → ℝ, that is, an element of Covector (Euclid P) n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ e : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ e → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range e) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α τ = α e) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α τ = -α e)
